title: Add calendar event by right clicking on a date in widget-clock
line: The clock popup's Add button now opens KOrganizer's new event editor on the day selected in the calendar.
explanation: The Events pane of the clock popup has an Add… button, but it only launched the calendar application with no arguments, so the new event had to be created and moved to the wanted day by hand in the app. Calendar apps share no standard way to start a new event on a date, but KOrganizer has long had D-Bus methods for it (goDate and openEventEditor on /Calendar, the same interface Kontact and KMail use). The button now passes the selected day; when the calendar app is KOrganizer the clock asks it to go to that day and open its new event editor (waiting for it to appear on the bus if it is not running yet), and any other calendar app is still just launched.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: add new events on the selected day

The Add button in the clock's popup only launched the calendar app, so
the event still had to be moved to the day selected in the popup. With
KOrganizer, it now opens the new event editor on that day over D-Bus.

BUG: 376531

media.caption: Master: 12 November selected in the clock popup, about to press Add…
Master: Add… only opens KOrganizer (stand-in with the same D-Bus interface); no event is started
Patched: 12 November selected with KOrganizer already running, about to press Add…
Patched, KOrganizer not running: Add… with 19 November selected starts it, goes to that day and opens the New Event editor for 19 November
